mentions.heading: Labor strikes and collective bargaining at customers and suppliers
mentions.risk_name: Labor strikes and union cost pressure
mentions.detail: GM, Ford and Stellantis strikes hurt 2023 results; CBA renegotiation could raise labor costs
mentions.quote: GM, Ford and Stellantis are among our largest customers, these labor strikes adversely impacted our financial condition, operating results and cash flows for the year ended December 31, 2023.

mentions.heading: Public health crises could adversely impact our business
mentions.detail: References COVID-19; no prolonged plant shutdowns in 2023-2025
mentions.quote: A significant public health crisis, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, could adversely impact our business as well as those of our suppliers and customers.

mentions.heading: Exposure to foreign currency fluctuations from global operations
mentions.detail: About 64% of 2025 revenue outside U.S.; key exposures Euro, Chinese Yuan, Mexican Peso
mentions.quote: Accordingly, significant changes in currency exchange rates, particularly the Euro, Chinese Yuan (Renminbi) and Mexican Peso, could cause fluctuations in the reported results of our businesses’ operations that could negatively affect our results of operations.

mentions.heading: Risks associated with doing business in various jurisdictions
mentions.detail: Most plants in Mexico, China, Asia Pacific, Europe, South America, Northern Africa; Ukraine-Russia, Middle East conflicts
mentions.quote: The majority of our manufacturing and distribution facilities are in Mexico, China and other countries in Asia Pacific, Eastern and Western Europe, South America and Northern Africa.

mentions.heading: Trade barriers and tariffs on global operations
mentions.detail: Tariffs, quotas, sanctions and export restrictions across global manufacturing footprint
mentions.quote: •tariffs, quotas, customs and other import or export restrictions and other trade barriers;

mentions.heading: Anti-bribery compliance in global operations
mentions.detail: Subject to U.S. FCPA, U.K. Bribery Act and similar laws
mentions.quote: •compliance with the requirements of an increasing body of applicable anti-bribery laws, including the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, the U.K. Bribery Act and similar laws of various other countries.
